hypothesis: Y034 showed full nine-slot assignment retention helps under repeated exposure. Test whether that advantage survives hibernation without observations, and whether retained previous assignments are useful upon reactivation after disjoint gaps.
freeze: Commit gap durations, skipped episode indices, cohorts, retention/erasure strategies, accounting, success categories and validity gates prior to first-use original run. No source/seed/threshold repair after results.
source: Exact Y030 SHA256-keyed collision/matching family, 16 motif identities/cells and seven active per observed episode. Max nine inactive cached assignments plus up to seven currently active placements. Two passive hiatus lengths with no matching or observations during gap.
arms: retain: freeze previous active and up-to-nine inactive assignment cache during hiatus and allow legal cached preferences after reactivation
erase: at hiatus boundary erase all stored inactive and previous-active assignments but keep evaluator-only history independent of policy
fairness: Both arms have identical pre-hibernation observations and fixed 16/7/9 resource capacities, no model calls and no intervention access to skipped/future geometries. All erasures charged as explicit modeled clearing operations. All returns evaluated against each arm's own evaluator history; neither reads evaluator history.
metrics: Per-heldout seed, gap, arm: seven legal matches per observed episode, post-reactivation matching cardinality and churn, aggregate returning-key churn, matching recursive calls, cache write/read/erase counts, cache occupancy and Hall oracle. Cost at w=3 and w=10 = recursive calls + writes + reads + erasures + w*churn; report all individual and negative outcomes.
classification: RETENTION_SURVIVES_INTERRUPTION if retained churn lower than erase on all four heldout seeds for both gap lengths AND retained net model cost lower at w3 in both gaps; MIXED if one gap has aggregate churn savings>0 while another gap <=0; otherwise NO_UNIVERSAL_RETENTION_GAIN. INVALID if cardinality/Hall, unique signature, capacity, prereg or source identity checks fail.
claim_limit: A finite synthetic interruption/reactivation and assignment-cache experiment, not proof of biological hibernation or learned cognitive regeneration. No accepted-ref changes.
